cases.title: Default Off and current acceptance beat cached On
Accepted response lost before Off remains recoverable
A rejected key never becomes queued work after re-enable
cases.unsafe: replay old rejected key when On

cases.title: Report/read rights do not confer correction, routing or finance
Unknown and wrong-payee reports remain scoped operational facts
Retry and independent duplicate assertions have different identities
Posting, transfer assertion and financial reversal do not imply custody
Exact existing recording lineage resolves intake without reposting
cases.unsafe: post again to repair missing status

cases.title: Correction and exact resolution preserve independent posted history
Local acceptance includes evidence, audit, receipt and required intent
cases.unsafe: save source then fail before intent

cases.title: Recovery neither resurrects old PII nor crosses current context
Missing source or recovery ownership has no local fallback

cases.title: A promise with a received-date field is not actual receipt
An ordinary report creates one operational intake and work intent
Independently authorized continuation survives Off and reporter departure
Handling first leaves recording work independent

decision: D33 optional authorized missionary reporting through P15, organization Off by default
key_rule: Off rejection is a terminal minimal no-effect receipt; re-enable requires deliberate new intent/key; accepted exact retry recovers under current disclosure even Off
limitations: Only synthetic finite standard-library examples ran; no application, database, provider, network, private data, older model or probe was executed.
Acceptance points and ordered schedules assume atomic serialized owner commands; no SQL/RLS, locks, transaction isolation, durable delivery, real concurrency or crash recovery is proved.
Receipt assertions are attributed reports, not verification of physical truth, custody, tax dates or money; financial and handling proof inputs are opaque owner-qualified fixtures.
No finance entry/posting/receipt/fulfillment producer, ledger, bank clearance, check matching, sender, file upload or valuation is implemented.
Duplicate resolution records qualified retained origins only; full canonical redirection, itemization, conflicting posted duplicates, appeal fanout and existing-task reconciliation remain unmodeled.

Permission and policy events are qualified inputs; real role grants, settings authority, clocks/expiry, field-level privacy, retained history, routing directory and browser context enforcement are untested.

Terminal Off rejection and transient source failure are distinct modeled outcomes; other rejection classes, cancellation, policy-command idempotency, restore and mixed-version deployment are not implemented.
Material correction versus source resolution is illustrated; full incidental edits, exact financial revision folds, exception closure and correction-retention contracts remain owner obligations.

Minimal receipts avoid returning old form bodies in these examples; payload hashes are equality witnesses, not a storage/privacy design. Actual retention, disposal, cryptographic privacy and all result surfaces are not proved.
Passing this model establishes no producer availability, deployed grant, production reliability or release readiness.
status: proposed D33 temporal rules and existing P15/P27 obligations illustrated; no runtime or ratification claim
